title: CodexCore purity: own double-precision math types, module glue file, purity check script
acceptance_criteria: CodexMath.h provides Codex::FVec2d, FVec3d, FQuatd, FMat3d (double, trivially copyable, static_assert), GravityMps2 = 9.80665, ForceToChaos = 100.0, TorqueToChaos = 10000.0, Pi.
Module glue is only in Private/CodexCoreModule.cpp; CodexCore.h is deleted.
CodexCore.Build.cs: FPSemantics = Precise, PCHUsage = NoPCHs, dependencies exactly {Core}.
tools/check_purity.ps1 exits 0 for CodexCore and non-zero on a banned include or token.
UBT CodexEditor Win64 Development builds with zero errors and zero warnings.
